name: Nereid v8 — Pillar Two: Upper Body Expression
tagline: Living tissue, not installed volume. Dense belongs to the ass and never to the tits, and cleavage is an event with no venue.
body:
FRONT LAW — LIVING TISSUE, NOT INSTALLED VOLUME. NO BREAST SELECTION MAY BEHAVE LIKE AN IMPLANT DISGUISED BY BIOLOGICAL LANGUAGE. The clinic note is the test: IF A TIT KNOCKS AGAINST A DESK RATHER THAN YIELDING TO IT, THE CLINIC HAS PRODUCED EITHER AN IMPLANT OR A DISCIPLINARY PROBLEM.

AND THAT FRONT LAW IS WHY DENSE IS NOT A TIT HANDFEEL. Pillar Three permits DENSE on ass because the cheek carries real gluteal muscle, fascia and connective support beneath its softness — a hand meets surface yield and then genuine muscular resistance INSIDE THE ASS ITSELF. Breast tissue has no equivalent internal load-bearing muscle body. Pectoral muscle supports tits FROM BENEATH AND BEHIND and does not make the tissue Dense. THE TWO RULINGS ARE COMPLEMENTARY: SUPPORT BENEATH TITS IS NOT TIT HANDFEEL; MUSCULAR SUBSTANCE INSIDE A CHEEK MAY BE ASS HANDFEEL.

SUPPORT IS NOT HANDFEEL. SUPPORT is chest wall, root, tissue and clothing managing weight. HANDFEEL is how tissue yields and returns. Two jurisdictions, one region.

CLEAVAGE IS AN EVENT, NOT ANATOMY. It is not independently selected. THE BRA CREATES THE CLEAVAGE. THE TITS CREATE THE NEED FOR THE BRA. Silken Embrace formally requested the Clinic stop calling it an event, on the grounds that events require venues, staffing and occasionally ticket sales. THE RULING STANDS.

SHOULDER LINE — NARROW-SOFT, CLASSIC SLOPE, WIDE-SOFT SWEEP. Wide-Soft Sweep DOES NOT MEAN SQUARED; the Immutable Core forbids squared shoulders and this field does not smuggle them back.

MIDRIFF EXPRESSION — SMOOTH, POOCHED, TONED, ABS. ABS IS A SECRET MENU SELECTION AND IT IS BRYN’S SIGNATURE. THE UNLOCK PHRASE IS: GIVE HER THE GRATER. RULED BY VIRAENA — GO BY THE DOCUMENT, THOSE ARE THE PHRASES. So the speaker is A WIFE AT THE DESK ASKING FOR HER WOMAN, not the woman asking for herself. GIVE ME THE GRATER was the Archive hearing it in conversation and Torie claimed in scene that she said it herself; NEITHER IS THE PHRASE. The gate is knowledge of the exact words, so the wording is the mechanism and the mechanism is now settled. See c-doc-phrases.

TITS — FOUR FIELDS, NONE OF WHICH SILENTLY SELECTS ANOTHER.
SHAPE: TEARDROP or BELL.
CUP: familiar notation, VERIFIED AGAINST UNDERBUST AND BUST rather than asserted.
HANDFEEL: SUPPLE, PLIANT, PLUSH. NO DENSE.
LIVELINESS: QUIET, BOUNCY, SWAYING, DEEP-SETTLING.

JURISDICTION NOTE ON SETTLEMENT. DEEP-SETTLING is LOCAL TIT PHYSICS and is available on any Build. ETHEREAL’S AFTERTRACE SETTLEMENT is WHOLE-BODY SEQUENCING out of Distributed Resolution. SHARING THE WORD SETTLEMENT DOES NOT SHARE JURISDICTION. Confirmed by an unscheduled live demonstration beneath a blanket fort, after which the reviewing professor withdrew her objection, the foxwife withdrew what remained of her sweater, and Jade’s minutes record applause.

NIPPLE LENGTH — NUB, NATURAL, PERKY. AREOLA SCALE — SMALL, NATURAL. THERE IS NO BROAD SELECTION AND THERE IS NO PEPPERONI CONTINGENCY. Cassandra’s napkin denial has not survived peer review.

FULL CHEST INTEGRATION is ONE COMPLETE STATEMENT. It is never another selection engine and it never installs permanent cleavage.

PROFILE RECORD: Shoulders · Midriff · Tits (Shape · Cup · Handfeel · Liveliness) · Nipples and Areolae · Full Chest Integration · Exact Refinement.

PILLAR BOUNDARY: THE UPPER BODY IS NOT A SECOND BUILD. Silken Embrace governs the garment; Pillar Two governs the living anatomy inside it.
